title: Work, for the Night Is Coming
description: Work, for the Night Is Coming in Tonic Solfa to WORK SONG: the solfa with the words, staff notation, the three verses, and a piano.
about: Anna L. Coghill wrote the words in Canada in 1854. Lowell Mason wrote the tune WORK SONG in 1864.
underlay: Work, for the night is com-ing, Work through the mor-ning hours; Work while the dew is spark-ling, Work ’mid spring-ing flow’rs. Work when the day grows bright_-er, Work in the glow-ing sun; Work, for the night is com-ing, When man’s work is done.

lines: Work, for the night is coming,
Work while the dew is sparkling,
Work when the day grows brighter,
Work, for the night is coming,
Work, for the night is coming,
Work, for the night is coming,
Work, for the night is coming,
While their bright tints are glowing,
Work till the last beam fadeth,
Work, while the night is dark’ning,
